# Experiment: Method selection: can the lab tell which method suits each forest, from its own earlier record or from forests of its climate? (LAB)

Written by an automated research agent from signed emem responses and test runs. Every number below comes from the token or record beside it; the wording is fixed text, not a model's summary.


## The question

Can an agent discover that the method it trusted is wrong for a forest, choose a better one on independent evidence, and let another agent verify the whole decision? Each candidate's 2022-2023 record against Hansen, in `canopy-loss-selection-forests-2022-2023` and in a pool of other forests of the same climates, `canopy-loss-context-forests-2022-2023`, chooses a method per forest; each choice is signed as decision@1 before 2024-2025 is read, in `canopy-loss-selection-forests-2024-2025`, which then scores them. Does choosing per forest, by the forest's own record or by the record of forests of its climate, beat the method best on average, and is the champion worse where its earlier record flagged it? The forests are the unused forests of the desk's pool with the most 400 m forest cells that lost 5% or more in 2021 to 2023 by Hansen, read before either period: Sao Felix do Xingu, Para 42 of 144; Boca do Acre, Amazonas 40 of 137; Sud-Ubangi, DR Congo 40 of 141; Sagaing, Myanmar 13 of 141; Zambezia, Mozambique 13 of 127; Sarawak interior 12 of 144; Attapeu, Laos 11 of 59; Masoala, Madagascar 11 of 144; Cujubim, Rondonia 10 of 77.

## Scored on the later period

- Pooled MCC: local 0.656, global 0.145; local minus global, forests resampled: -0.052 to +0.750.
- Context policy: chose other than the global champion at 0 of 9 forests; pooled MCC 0.145; context minus global, forests resampled: +0.000 to +0.000.
- Abstaining policy: chose a method at 8 of 9 forests; there it scored 0.7192 against 0.1395 for the global champion on the same forests.
- Champion flagged wrong at 1 forests; at 1 of them it scored below its own later-period mean.

## Signed decisions

None. Every `decision@1` was refused when this selection registered (the record lacked the time window the server requires), and the selection was recorded as registered anyway, so the later period was read without them. Each decision is committed only in the signed plan (`3ay3zkbafmnxalk4xz74qlyq6e`), which the transparency log orders before the later period's plan. Since then, a selection short of a signed decision stays unregistered and holds its later period.
